capability_source_note: targets.<key>.capabilities and capability_gaps are DERIVED from the capability registry. Regenerate with `bash scripts/check-platform-targets.sh . --sync-capabilities`.

capability_gaps.extension_install: Claude installs plugins, not git-URL extensions.
capability_gaps.hooks: No hooks are shipped: there is no .claude/settings.json (reserved for the owner) and no hooks/ directory. Claude Code supports hooks; book chapter 16 shows how to add them.
capability_gaps.mcp: No .mcp.json is shipped, so this repo declares no MCP servers. Book chapters 12 and 13 cover adding one.
capability_gaps.plugin_marketplace: This repo is a book, not a plugin: it ships no plugin manifest and is not listed in any marketplace.
capability_gaps.statusline: No status line script is shipped. Book chapter 18 covers configuring one.

capability_gaps.extension_install: Codex installs plugins, not git-URL extensions.
capability_gaps.hooks: No hooks are shipped for Codex.
capability_gaps.mcp: No MCP config is shipped for Codex (no .codex/config.toml).
capability_gaps.plugin_marketplace: This repo is a book, not a plugin: it ships no plugin manifest and is not listed in any marketplace.
capability_gaps.skill_auto_invocation: No skill is shipped for Codex (see skills).
capability_gaps.skills: Codex reads AGENTS.md natively. This repo ships no .agents/skills/ tree, so Codex does not see the project skill in .claude/skills/.
capability_gaps.slash_commands: No Codex commands or skills are shipped.

capability_gaps.extension_install: Cursor installs plugins, not git-URL extensions.
capability_gaps.hooks: No hooks are shipped for Cursor (no .cursor/hooks.json).
capability_gaps.mcp: No MCP config is shipped for Cursor (no .mcp.json, no .cursor/mcp.json).
capability_gaps.plugin_marketplace: This repo is a book, not a plugin: it ships no plugin manifest and is not listed in any marketplace.
capability_gaps.skill_auto_invocation: No skill is shipped for Cursor (see skills).
capability_gaps.skills: This repo ships no Cursor skill. .cursor/rules/000-project.mdc points the agent at AGENTS.md, which carries the same working rules.
capability_gaps.slash_commands: No Cursor commands or skills are shipped.

capability_gaps.extension_install: This repo is not a Gemini extension: it ships no gemini-extension.json.
capability_gaps.hooks: No hooks are shipped for Gemini.
capability_gaps.mcp: No MCP server config is shipped for Gemini.
capability_gaps.plugin_marketplace: Gemini installs extensions from a git URL; there is no marketplace listing, and this repo is not an extension.
capability_gaps.skill_auto_invocation: No skill is shipped for Gemini (see skills).
capability_gaps.skills: This repo ships no Gemini adapter: no gemini-extension.json, no .gemini/ mirror, no GEMINI.md. Gemini CLI reads GEMINI.md by default; set context.fileName in Gemini settings to include AGENTS.md to load this repo's instructions.

capability_gaps.hooks: No hooks are shipped: OpenCode's lifecycle mechanism is its JS/TS plugin API, and this repo ships no plugin module.
capability_gaps.mcp: No opencode.json or other MCP config is shipped.
capability_gaps.plugin_marketplace: OpenCode has no plugin marketplace; this repo is cloned, not installed.
